title: Combustion - 123 school
heading: Combustion
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.

questions.q: What is a fuel?
questions.a: A substance that you burn to get heat (energy)

questions.q: Name the three things needed to make something burn (fire triangle)
questions.a: Fuel, oxygen and a temperature above the ignition temperature

questions.q: What is the ignition temperature?
questions.a: The temperature at which a substance starts to burn

questions.q: Which gas from the air is needed for combustion?
questions.a: Oxygen

questions.q: What is a combustion called in which enough oxygen is present?
questions.a: Complete combustion

questions.q: What is a combustion called in which too little oxygen is present?
questions.a: Incomplete combustion

questions.q: Which two substances are formed in the complete combustion of a hydrocarbon?
questions.a: Carbon dioxide and water

questions.q: Which substances can be formed in the incomplete combustion of a hydrocarbon?
questions.a: Carbon monoxide (CO), soot (C), and also water. Sometimes carbon dioxide as well.

questions.q: What colour is the flame in the incomplete combustion of natural gas?
questions.a: Yellow

questions.q: What colour is the flame in complete combustion in a burner?
questions.a: Blue

questions.q: Why is carbon monoxide (CO) dangerous?
questions.a: It is poisonous and you cannot smell it

questions.q: What is soot?
questions.a: Fine black particles of carbon (C) that are formed in incomplete combustion

questions.q: Which two elements are in a hydrocarbon?
questions.a: Carbon and hydrogen (C and H)

questions.q: Which three fuels are fossil fuels?
questions.a: Coal, crude oil and natural gas

questions.q: What is the molecular formula of methane, the main component of natural gas?
questions.a: CH<sub>4</sub>

questions.q: How do you show that water is formed in a combustion?
questions.a: White copper(II) sulfate turns blue

questions.q: How do you show that carbon dioxide is formed in a combustion?
questions.a: Limewater turns cloudy (white)

questions.q: Balance: CH<sub>4</sub> + O<sub>2</sub> → CO<sub>2</sub> + H<sub>2</sub>O
questions.a: CH<sub>4</sub> + 2 O<sub>2</sub> → CO<sub>2</sub> + 2 H<sub>2</sub>O (left 1 C, 4 H and 4 O, right 1 C, 4 H and 4 O)

questions.q: Balance: C + O<sub>2</sub> → CO<sub>2</sub>
questions.a: C + O<sub>2</sub> → CO<sub>2</sub> (already balanced: left 1 C and 2 O, right 1 C and 2 O)

questions.q: Balance: 2 CH<sub>4</sub> + 3 O<sub>2</sub> → … CO + … H<sub>2</sub>O (incomplete combustion)
questions.a: 2 CH<sub>4</sub> + 3 O<sub>2</sub> → 2 CO + 4 H<sub>2</sub>O (left 2 C, 8 H and 6 O, right 2 C, 8 H and 6 O)

questions.q: Balance: CH<sub>4</sub> + O<sub>2</sub> → C + H<sub>2</sub>O (incomplete combustion with soot)
questions.a: CH<sub>4</sub> + O<sub>2</sub> → C + 2 H<sub>2</sub>O (left 1 C, 4 H and 2 O, right 1 C, 4 H and 2 O)

questions.q: Balance: C<sub>4</sub>H<sub>10</sub> + O<sub>2</sub> → CO<sub>2</sub> + H<sub>2</sub>O (butane, complete combustion)
questions.a: 2 C<sub>4</sub>H<sub>10</sub> + 13 O<sub>2</sub> → 8 CO<sub>2</sub> + 10 H<sub>2</sub>O (left 8 C, 20 H and 26 O, right 8 C, 20 H and 26 O)

questions.q: Balance: Mg + O<sub>2</sub> → MgO (burning of magnesium)
questions.a: 2 Mg + O<sub>2</sub> → 2 MgO

questions.q: When 16 g of methane burns with 64 g of oxygen, 44 g of carbon dioxide and some water are formed. How many g of water are formed?
questions.a: Mass on the left = mass on the right: 16 + 64 = 80 g. Water = 80 − 44 = 36 g

questions.q: At high temperature in a car engine, nitrogen and oxygen react. Which substances are formed?
questions.a: Nitrogen oxides (NO and NO<sub>2</sub>)

questions.q: Which gas causes acid rain (together with nitrogen oxides)?
questions.a: Sulfur dioxide (SO<sub>2</sub>)

questions.q: What happens to a burning candle under an upturned glass?
questions.a: The candle goes out, because the oxygen is used up

questions.q: Which extinguisher do you never use on a fat fire?
questions.a: Water. It sinks below the hot fat, boils and makes burning fat splash around.

questions.q: Why does a fire blanket put out a fire?
questions.a: The oxygen can no longer reach the fuel

questions.q: Why does water cool a fire?
questions.a: The temperature falls below the ignition temperature

questions.q: With which process do you make petrol and diesel from crude oil?
questions.a: Fractional distillation

questions.q: Which substance in the air is mainly responsible for the enhanced greenhouse effect?
questions.a: Carbon dioxide (CO<sub>2</sub>)

questions.q: Why is there more and more CO<sub>2</sub> in the air because of humans?
questions.a: Because we burn large amounts of fossil fuels

questions.q: Name two consequences of the enhanced greenhouse effect
questions.a: For example: the temperature on Earth rises, ice melts, the sea level rises, extreme weather becomes more frequent

questions.q: How can you make sure there is less CO<sub>2</sub> emission?
questions.a: For example: use energy more economically, use solar energy and wind energy, drive less, plant trees
